comparison_with_the_sealed_pre_torch_N.reading: The new environment's floor is at least as tight as the sealed one: 0 differences in all three pairs, against 11/0/11 there. N is RE-SET here, not inherited from G0-prime, because the environment that produced the sealed N no longer exists on this machine.

cross_environment_scope: Control-arm byte-identity holds within one tree and one environment. It is not guaranteed across environments. See experiments/G0-prime/registration.json -> AMD-G0P-01 and experiments/MP-E8/registration.json -> AMD-MPE8-01.

environment.why_that_matters: N is a wall-clock-sensitive quantity and the disputed row is gated on 2.0 s of real time, so the three clones ran one after another with nothing else on the machine. Concurrent load would move the very field being measured.

question: What is the noise floor N in the torch environment introduced by D-MPE8-02, and does arm A on the current tree land inside it? Condition (b) of the MP-E8 pre-run conditions depends on this number, which is why it is an artifact and not prose.

across_environments.verdict: PASS for the designated reference artifact: 0 of 3,672 rows differ from the sealed same-flag artifact and 0 from the same-head pre-change run. The EARLIER run in the same environment (armA_tier40_newenv.json) differs by 1 row OUTSIDE the registered tolerance cells, and five other artifacts agree against it, so the row is run-level unstable rather than environment-driven. That artifact is superseded.

r13_field_level_verdict.cost_fields_excluded_on_purpose: wall clock and token counts are not compared; identity is.

excluded_cells.candidate_not_excluded: control/3/live -- gated the same way, NOT in the registered list, and NOT excluded here. Excluding it would widen a tolerance after the artifacts it grades already exist, which is an R2 event. Escalated as D-MPE8-05.
excluded_cells.why_registered_cells_are_excluded: the speech-act row in those cells is gated on the 2.0 s refractory, so its surface string depends on wall clock; registered before this number existed

within_new_environment.verdict: PASS. Three full three-arm clones in the torch environment are row-for-row identical on the identity fields, including the control arm.

supersedes_nothing: experiments/MP-E8/results/noise_floor_reverification.json stays as the record of the PRE-TORCH environment. This file is the torch-environment verdict; the two answer different questions and are not merged.

verdict.caveat: Condition (b) is satisfied against armA_tier40_inertness.json as the arm-A tier-40 reference. It is NOT satisfied against armA_tier40_newenv.json, which is why that artifact is superseded and why D-MPE8-05 is open.
